metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.9 · 1986 · An American Tail
metas.description: While emigrating to the United States, a young Russian mouse gets separated from his family and must locate them while trying to survive in a new country.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.5 · 1991 · An American Tail: Fievel Goes West
metas.description: Fievel's family decides to move out to the West, unaware that they are falling into a trap perpetrated by a smooth-talking cat.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.6 · 1998 · An American Tail: The Treasure of Manhattan Island
metas.description: The Fievel mouse discovers the secret world of mice lying deep beneath the city.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.7 · 1999 · An American Tail: The Mystery of the Night Monster
metas.description: Fievel and other mice haunt the monster, with the result they want to track him down.
